first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A foreground person holding a gun, with short brown hair, a dark blue-gray top, brown trousers, a shoulder strap, and a holster at the waist.

entities.name: green foreground counter
entities.identification: A teal wooden foreground counter with a damaged plank-style countertop and an open leg frame.

entities.name: shop stall with a red roller shutter
entities.identification: A red rectangular shop stall on the right side of the passageway, with a large red pattern on its gray roller shutter.

entities.name: wet flagstone passageway
entities.identification: A gray-brown stone-paved surface leading between the stalls to the steps, with wet, reflective areas scattered across it.

entities.name: distant curved building
entities.identification: A light-colored multistory building at the rear right, with a curved corner, green balcony edges, and rows of windowpanes.

entities.name: armed person near the steps
entities.identification: The original ID corresponds to the group consisting of the active person in front of the steps and the nearby people lying horizontally; do not reassign this group to a single person.

entities.name: green open goods stall
entities.identification: A partial goods stall visible at the extreme right edge in the final segment, showing a green lower panel, a diagonal brace, and interior vertical slats.

entities.name: orange-fruit table
entities.identification: A low orange wooden display table in front of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with horizontal slats on its front.

entities.name: blue-and-white steps
entities.identification: Wide multilevel steps extending horizontally across the far end of the passageway, with light-gray treads and blue-and-white square-tiled risers.

entities.name: raised market hall
entities.identification: The exposed reddish-brown sloping roof and dark projecting eaves of the market building behind the steps.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A short handgun held by Person A, with a silver-gray rectangular upper section connected to a darker grip area.

entities.name: sky between the buildings
entities.identification: Light-blue sky and pale white cloud coloration in the gap between the rooftops.

entities.name: surrounding market buildings
entities.identification: The group of blue-gray and yellow-brown buildings on both sides of the passageway, excluding the separately listed shop stall, market hall, and curved building.

entities.name: light-colored cloth bag
entities.identification: A bulging beige-gray bag-shaped object on the far side of the green foreground counter's countertop.

entities.name: market container
entities.identification: The group of brown bottles, yellow-green bottles and jars, and bucket-shaped containers around the counter and small table.

entities.name: pineapple
entities.identification: Fruit on the orange-fruit table with a yellow-gray-green oval body and a gray-green crown of pointed leaves.

entities.name: smoke and dust near the counter
entities.identification: A translucent reddish-brown and pale-gray mist-like effect above and beyond the counter.

entities.name: stacked box-shaped goods
entities.identification: Stacked beige-gray and gray-brown rectangular goods in the small-table area on the right, some with blue-green or dark lids.

entities.name: small light-green table
entities.identification: A light gray-green wooden table at the near end of the shop stall with a red roller shutter, with a long narrow tabletop, slender legs, and crossbars.

entities.name: scattered papers on the ground
entities.identification: Light-gray and off-white sheet-like papers scattered across the passageway.

entities.name: shallow puddle in the passageway
entities.identification: Irregular light-colored reflective water surfaces in low areas of the wet flagstones.
